visibility.source: GT occupancy + GT poses of the five permitted causal frames
visibility.rule: every voxel a ray enters up to and including the first GT-occupied voxel is observed
visibility.window_scope: our five causal frames; OccAny's 5-frame arm reads t..t+40 and is NOT limited by these masks

statistics.pairing: every arm resampled on the same anchors, one pass
statistics.global_iou_rule: recomputed from summed TP/FP/FN per resample
